pokedexEntries.rb: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

pokedexEntries.go: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CONSTRICT its prey and enemies.

pokedexEntries.si: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

pokedexEntries.cr: When its 80 feelers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.

pokedexEntries.ru: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This POKéMON’s outburst creates rough waves around it.

pokedexEntries.sa: TENTACRUEL has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.

pokedexEntries.fr: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

pokedexEntries.lg: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokedexEntries.em: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

pokedexEntries.di: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

pokedexEntries.prl: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.

pokedexEntries.pt: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

pokedexEntries.hg: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.

pokedexEntries.ss: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

pokedexEntries.bw: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

pokedexEntries.x: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokedexEntries.y: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

pokedexEntries.or: Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon’s outburst creates rough waves around it.

pokedexEntries.as: Tentacruel has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.

pokedexEntries.su: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

pokedexEntries.mo: Although these Pokémon are rare, when a large outbreak of them occurs, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

pokedexEntries.us: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

pokedexEntries.um: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it’s a warning sign.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

pokedexEntries.sw: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

pokedexEntries.bd: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

pokedexEntries.shp: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.

pokedexEntries.la: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

pokedexEntries.sc: On the rare occasions that large outbreaks of Tentacruel occur, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

pokedexEntries.vi: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.
